Name: Better Calendar Panel
Author: lvxvi719
Description:
[b][size=5][color=#ea9999]Features / 功能[/color][/size][/b]
[size=3][color=#f6b26b]日历上的最晚种植作物提示：现在会根据作物的最晚成熟日期会在日历格子上会出现一个祝尼魔图标的提示（有四种图标可供选择），右上角也会显示该天最晚可种植的作物（可勾选施用肥料）[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#6fa8dc]The latest planting crop reminder on the calendar: Now, based on the latest maturity date of the crops, a symbol icon of Junimo will appear in the calendar grid (there are four icons to choose from), and on the upper right corner, the latest crop that can be planted on that day will be displayed (you can check to apply fertilizer)[/color][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47884/47884-1790491155-612850943.png[/img]

[size=3][color=#f6b26b]作物每日利润，开启后在作物种植提示框上会显示该作物种植的每日利润（农业学家等会影响利润计算的的技能需要在设置里手动开启）[/color]
[color=#6fa8dc]Daily crop profit: When enabled, the daily profit of each crop will be displayed in the crop planting prompt (skills that affect profit calculation, such as Agronomist, must be manually enabled in the settings).[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#f6b26b]现在日历上一天如果有多个人过生日的话会在左下角会有一个礼物盒的小图标提示。[/color] [/size]
[size=3][color=#6d9eeb]Now, if there are multiple people having their birthdays on the same day on the calendar, a small gift box icon will be displayed in the lower left corner to indicate this.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#f6b26b]当一天有多个npc生日时滑动鼠标滚轮可以翻页[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#6d9eeb]When there are multiple NPC birthdays on a single day, scrolling the mouse wheel can turn the pages. [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#f6b26b]当鼠标移动到日历上的某一天时会显示当天生日的npc最爱的礼物和喜欢的礼物并且自己有的物品会呈深色且优先显示。 [/color]
[color=#6d9eeb]When the mouse is moved over a certain day in the calendar, it will show the favorite gift and preferred gift of the NPC on that day, and the items one has will be displayed in a darker color and given priority.[/color][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47884/47884-1790491187-1069784660.png[/img]

[size=3][color=#f6b26b]同时也会显示npc的位置方便送礼[/color]
[color=#6d9eeb]It will also display the location of the NPC to facilitate the gift-giving process[/color][color=#3d85c6].[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#f6b26b]渐进式解锁（将会逐步发现npc所喜爱的礼物）开启后所有的npc将会显示“还不知道喜欢什么礼物”只有当你把一个物品送给npc后才会在提示框里显示出来[/color][/size]
[color=#6d9eeb][size=3]Progressive Unlock (The NPC's favorite gifts will gradually be discovered.) is activated. After activation, all NPCs will display "Not sure what gift to choose yet". This will only be shown in the prompt box after you give an item to an NPC.[/size][/color]

[color=#ea9999][size=5][b]Customizable options/ 可自定义内容[/b][/size][/color]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47884/47884-1790491087-478836849.png[/img]

[color=#ea9999][size=3]1.5.3更新内容
添加作物每日利润的显示（按照作物售价-商店售价（种子价格✖2）计算）[/size][/color]

Manifest.Name: 更好的日历面板-Better Calendar Panel
Manifest.Description: Hover calendar dates to see birthday NPCs, their loved/liked gifts (with your owned items highlighted), AND their current location — with color presets, multi-NPC pagination, i18n support.
